text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a rare display, I find Air Groove fixed on her phone in spite of the approaching start of the race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober just messaged me. She's coming to watch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If she's watching, then I have no choice but to deliver my challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can sense that Air Groove is ready to go! I just need to send her off and trust her to give this race her all.
